headline: Amodei essay calls for global AI slowdown; Altman, Musk, Hassabis cosign
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published "We Must Pace the Frontier," urging AI labs to slow capability development citing loss-of-control, cyber and bio-misuse risks. OpenAI's Sam Altman, Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis and xAI's Elon Musk cosigned the statement. The message triggered a broad AI-stock selloff Monday and pressured chip and memory names hardest into Tuesday's open.

headline: OpenAI shelves 2026 IPO on AI safety concerns
summary: Sam Altman told Fortune that an OpenAI public listing this year would be "ill-advised" as the company works through alignment and government-regulation frameworks. SoftBank, an OpenAI backer, closed nearly 11% lower in Tokyo overnight; the delay is another leg of the broader AI-pace debate driving Tuesday's futures lower.

headline: Memory chips lead AI selloff: SK Hynix -7%, Micron and SanDisk -6%
summary: Memory names took the brunt of Monday's AI-pace selloff and continued weak into Tuesday's pre-market. SK Hynix fell 7% as NVIDIA's primary HBM supplier, Micron (MU) dropped ~5%, SanDisk ~6% and Western Digital ~4%. The Roundhill Memory ETF slid 7% - roughly 3x QQQ's 2% decline - confirming the pressure is concentrated in memory rather than broad tech. Micron reports earnings September 30.

headline: Philadelphia Semiconductor Index -5.9%; NVDA -3.4%, INTC -5.6%
summary: The SOX index tumbled 5.9% Monday on the Amodei/Altman AI-slowdown call, cutting its 2026 gain to 57%. NVIDIA fell 3.4% and Intel 5.6% in the session; Asian chip peers followed lower overnight. Futures point to further softness at Tuesday's US cash open with S&P 500 futures down ~0.6%.

headline: 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% for first time since 2007 ahead of expected Fed hike
summary: The US 10-year yield broke above 5% Tuesday for the fifth consecutive session of gains, driven by higher oil prices and sticky inflation. Fed funds futures price ~92% probability of a 25bp rate hike at Wednesday's FOMC - the first hike since July 2023. Long-duration growth names, including AI software and datacenter capex plays, are most exposed on the multiple.

headline: Constellation adds 920 MW of long-term nuclear PPAs with investment-grade offtakers
summary: Constellation Energy disclosed an additional 920 MW of 15-20 year power-purchase agreements for nuclear generation with a diverse set of investment-grade customers, with contracted deliveries beginning between 2029 and 2032. The tranche extends CEG's visible nuclear cash-flow ladder and reinforces the datacenter-nuclear supply pipeline alongside Vistra's recent Meta and Amazon deals.

headline: ASML breaks ground on second Netherlands campus; TSMC and Samsung target 2028 High-NA EUV DRAM
summary: ASML broke ground on its second major industrial campus in Eindhoven to support High-NA EUV expansion, with each scanner priced around $380-$400M. TSMC and Samsung separately announced enhanced ASML partnerships targeting High-NA EUV for high-volume DRAM manufacturing by 2028; SK Hynix has confirmed the same 2028 target. CEO Christophe Fouquet tied the expansion directly to AI-driven demand.
